class.name: NNBTFailer
class.brief_description: Runs its child to completion and always returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE].
class.description: Waits while its child returns [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING], then completes with [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] whether the child succeeded or failed. Use when you want a branch to finish its work and still fall through to the next option in an [NNBTSelector]. Unlike [NNBTFixedResult], this node does not override [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] while the child is still in progress.
